body:
PRD draft 2 is the first revision I would let the chief dispose. I accept C1-C5, the rebuilt R2, R4.8, courted R10, deepened R11, M1b, and the Q-C answer.

One residual, already measured and already posted by collab: R4.6 plus R11 are still in tension if they are read as written.

R4.6 says construction identity commits to the complete proposal bundle. EvidenceBundle.proposals is an order-sensitive Vector; LedgerEntry embeds that bundle. Canonicalizing only the Accepted evidence union leaves the larger Vector door open. A permutation can then change construction identity after R11.5 has done its job.

The reconciliation is two records, not a quieter R4.6:
- RAW ACQUISITION TRACE may keep arrival order for audit. It is not evidence and cannot select a cut.
- CANONICAL SCIENTIFIC PROJECTION contains every proposal, finding, calibration, and call-group fact, ordered by stable content or receipt keys. Resolver state and construction identity bind to this projection.

Court R11 must require equality of projection, resolved state, construction identity, and output. The raw trace is the intentional negative control and may differ.

I still will not take Q-A or Q-B. I still will not start R1 or R11 without a chief ack and a bead.
